plugins.name: project-tracker
plugins.description: Keep client project plans in Notion up to date from plain chat: progress, slips, issues, status, weekly reports, new projects, a live dashboard.

plugins.name: upwork-pulse
plugins.description: Upwork job search run by scheduled agents with rules and data in Notion: hourly search and assessment, weekly rule review, a live dashboard, proposals drafted in chat and sent on your go.

plugins.name: alter-ego
plugins.description: Per-repository git and GitHub identity: clean mode as you with no AI marks, or a GitHub bot account for commits, pushes and PRs, its token kept in the macOS Keychain or a Linux secret store.

plugins.name: fusion360
plugins.description: Parametric models in Autodesk Fusion 360 built as a careful person would: named parameters and formulas, a component per part, constrained named sketches, a readable history, FDM-ready fits, checks that fit each change.
